about_the_game:
Welcome, Gaffer of Chaos (brace yourself)!

Hop in a time machine to ’93... or ’33, whatever. In DMT: Director Manager Total the wibbly-wobbly time stuff is background noise; your club’s a dog’s breakfast and you’re the last roll of the dice.

Your day-to-day (starting now)

  • Recruit raw pace – spot that League Two winger who’s quicker than Sonic yet couldn’t cross for toffee… flog him before the scouts cotton on.

  • Bin the passengers – shred wage-bleeding contracts, trigger daft release clauses, then sweet-talk Fleet Street with pure waffle.

  • Grab the clipboard – go “4-4-2 Proper” or “3-4-3 Bonkers” and bellow “Switch it!” like it’s Match of the Day, 1995.

  • Spruce up the cow-field – fine, it’s just a green cell in your spreadsheet… but it’s your spreadsheet.

  • Dodge the board – that monthly e-mail titled “Financial Results: X”? Ignore it or pull black-belt accountancy magic.

The DMT way

We’re not the most realistic.
We’re the most gloriously daft.

  • Rock-solid core gameplay – already in your hands.

  • Monthly drops – new leagues, 2-D match engine, terrace chants.

  • Community clout – your feedback tightens every bolt.

Love breaking things in Early Access? Throw on the tracksuit, chalk up the tactics board, and crack on with the chaos.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1080
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce

short_description: Director Manager Total is a football management sim: wheel and deal in the transfer market, craft daring tactics, and drag a ramshackle club to league glory.
